description: Get GHS (Globally Harmonized System) hazard classification for a compound — signal words (Danger/Warning), hazard statements (H-codes), precautionary statements (P-codes), pictograms. Essential for chemical safety assessments (PubChem / NCBI)

cid.description: PubChem Compound ID (CID) — returns GHS hazard classification, pictograms, signal words

name: chemistry.pubchem.hazards

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Chemical Hazard Classification (GHS)
